sloka: तौ तु रोषपरीताङ्गौ नर्दन्तावभ्यधावताम्।उद्यतासी रणे हृष्टौ युधि शस्त्रविशारदौ ।। ६.९८.३१ ।।
transliteration: tau tu roṣaparītāṅgau nardantāvabhyadhāvatām।udyatāsī raṇe hṛṣṭau yudhi śastraviśāradau ।। 6.98.31 ।।

translations.english: Both being scourge of their enemies, both heroes wrestling were exhausted with fighting. Then the Rakshasa picked up a sword lying not far from there along with a shield.
